parsed.root_cause: The incident was caused by the Kubernetes control plane components (Controller Manager and Scheduler) becoming unreachable, likely due to expired client certificates used for authentication.
evidence: Alerts indicate a client certificate used to authenticate to the kubernetes apiserver is expiring in less than 24 hours.
Prometheus target discovery shows KubeControllerManager and KubeScheduler have disappeared, indicating they are down or unable to communicate with the API server.
K8s events show scheduling failures (FailedScheduling) and volume attachment issues (VolumeFailedDelete), which are symptoms of a non-functional control plane.
